flagged.title: Sewa and the Sangat
flagged.reason: The video attributes the Biblical proverb 'iron sharpens iron' (Proverbs 27:17) to the Guru Granth Sahib and explicitly encourages GCSE students to quote it in their exams, which is mark-affecting.

mark_affecting.quote: Just as iron is sharpened by contact with iron, the soul is strengthened and refined by contact with God-centred people. Definitely write that one down... highly memorable analogy to drop into your written exam
